👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, pichle kuch dino mein Bharat aur Pakistan ke beech tensions apne boiling point par aa chuke hain. Pahalgam attacks, Operation Sindoor aur Pakistan ke retaliation ke baad, Bharat aur Pakistan dono hi red alert par aa chuke hain!!

Inhi acts ke saath India aur Pakistan ke beech tensions badhte ja rahe hain!!!
Saath hi saath, puri duniya ko ye dar hai ki India aur Pakistan dono hi nuclear powers hain jinke war se poori duniya mein tabahi mach sakti hai!!!

Lekin sochne wali baat ye hai ki 1947 se lekar 1965 war tak, yahan tak ki Kargil war se lekar Pahalgam attack aur aaj ke escalation tak, saare ke saare conflicts aur wars sirf aur sirf Kashmir ko lekar hi shuru hue hain!!

Toh sawaal ye hai ki,

India aur Pakistan dono ke liye Kashmir itna important kyun hai?

Kashmir mein aise kaunse geopolitical factors hain jo Kashmir ko Bharat ka itna ahem hissa banate hain??

Pakistan har baar Kashmir ko Bharat se chheenne ki koshish kyun karta hai?

Aur is baar, Bharat Pakistan ko rokne ke liye kaunse strategies ka istemaal kar raha hai??
